children: The current-month Hang Seng China Enterprises Index Futures open interest stood at 229,489 contracts yesterday, up 1,449 from the previous day. Including other contract months, total open interest rose 5,264 to 268,175, according to ETNet.
Net open interest in the current-month contract was 75,249, down 1,822, while net open interest across all months was 104,010, up 1,748. The figures include current-month night-session open interest.

title: Hang Seng China Enterprises Index Futures Open Interest Rises To 229,489
